content.summary: I accept this final version within the literature-review mandate. Fresh inspection confirms accurate source-relative positioning, explicit external I(27) attribution, and no asserted new extremal bound or global originality. Exact manuscript and canonical snapshot hashes match. This acceptance does not certify exhaustive prior-art coverage or independently reproduce the cited enumeration.

checks.observation: F16 reports the intersecting maximum 27 and 54 <= f(4,3) <= 83. F17 gives the earlier 85-point reduction and conditional G(80). The final manuscript explicitly acknowledges hypothetical-class emptiness under external I(27), presents Fin53 as a smaller local proof target, and leaves exclusion and both boundary profiles unproved locally. Generic counting arguments carry no established literature-wide novelty claim. No material attribution issue remains.
